blocks.caption: Angel Wings, one of the six legendary pairs

blocks.text: Sit down, traveller. You have looked up at the sky once too often, and now it is looking back at you. This book is my chronicle of wings: how they are made, how they fly, and where the rarest of them sleep.
Simply Wings gives you real flight. Not a gliding cloak, but wings that beat, climb, hover, dive and brake, each pair with its own temper.
Wings are not worn in an armour slot. A pair comes as an item: right-click it and it is consumed, added to your collection forever and equipped at once.

Switching pairs is instant and free, and you may also fly with none at all. A pair you own can never be lost or traded away. Right-click a pair you already own and it is only equipped: the item stays in your hand, ready for the Offering Fountain.
Press J (the Wings menu key, rebindable in Controls), or click the small wing button under your inventory. That button appears once you own your first pair.

On the left, every pair in the world, with its rarity. Pairs you lack are greyed out, and the two mythic pairs hide as ??? until you own them. On the right, you turn slowly on a pedestal wearing the selected pair, beside its stats and your collection bonus. Equip and Unequip do what they promise.
Common (1 pair), Rare (21), Epic (11), Legendary (6) and Mythic (2). Every pair you own also strengthens all the others, so the collection is the true road to mastery.
The chapters follow a flyer's road: first flight, the art of flying, crafting, the workshops, the End and its dragons, summoning, and at last the Furies. The links at the bottom of a page lead on.

Numbers given here are the default values of the server config. A server owner may change them, so trust your own wings first. Hover any item of the mod to read its lore and a riddle telling where it is found. With JEI installed, every recipe and drop is shown there too.
